recommend.description: proceed: nothing derivable blocks it. amend: a derivable defect in the record. recut: the decomposition does not hold. resurvey: the premise is wrong, not the commitment.

checks.description: The four derivations, each with what you found. Never empty.

status.description: underivable means you could NOT derive this check — a missing yardstick, not a failed one. Never use broken for something you could not check.

findings.description: Empty when recommending proceed. Every entry must cite what it falsifies.

claim-id.description: The id of the design claim this finding is about — the slug shown in brackets, WITHOUT the brackets. Empty string when the finding is about no single claim, or the design lists invariants with no ids.

check.description: The derived check this finding shows broken. Empty string when it bears on none of the four.

confirmed.description: The IDS of the design claims you checked and found to hold — the bracketed slugs, without the brackets. Empty when the design lists invariants with no ids. Ids, not sentences: a confirmation worded differently each round cannot be matched to the claim it is about.

asks.description: The question the human still has to answer, with everything derived taken off the table. Required whatever you recommend. Never answer it yourself.
